name: Crossref
label: Crossref
description: Crossref official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: works_search, work_get, funders. Docs: https://www.crossref.org/documentation/retrieve-metadata/rest-api/. Crossref REST (https://api.crossref.org/ or versioned https://api.crossref.org/v1/). Polite pool via mailto= (or User-Agent). Metadata Plus uses header Crossref-Plus-API-Token: Bearer — not wired in this node. Metadata licence; Plus for heavy commercial. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Crossref request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"works_search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: works_search | work_get | funders. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'works_search'.

schema.label: doi
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `doi` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: filter
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `filter` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: mailto
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `mailto` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `offset` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `query` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: rows
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `rows` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: works_search | work_get | funders. Example: 'works_search'.

configurationParameters.label: Mailto
configurationParameters.description: Polite-pool contact email sent as mailto=. Recommended.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
